# Imagem sintética para avaliação

Arquivo: `synthetic-scenes.png`, 1536 × 1024 px. Modo: geração nova com a ferramenta integrada ImageGen, sem imagem de referência. Pessoas e cenas fictícias. Usada apenas como entrada de teste, sem alegação de foto de câmera real ou calibração. Nenhuma foto pessoal foi enviada.

Prompt utilizado:

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: SYNTHETIC photography test contact sheet for visually evaluating a local photo editor's color filters. Generate one high-quality 3 columns by 2 rows contact sheet, six equal panels with NO gutters, NO borders, NO writing or labels, exact straight grid. Overall landscape 1536x1024 or larger same aspect. Each panel should look like a natural neutral ungraded digital photograph, not film-styled, with authentic texture and smooth tonal transitions. TOP LEFT: head and shoulders portrait of a fictional adult woman with fair skin and auburn hair, soft daylight, neutral gray background, naturally visible skin pores, neutral clothing. TOP MIDDLE: head and shoulders portrait of a fictional adult woman with medium brown skin and dark hair, open shade with neutral white balance, natural skin texture, gray-green background. TOP RIGHT: head and shoulders portrait of a fictional adult man with deep dark brown skin, soft directional daylight, preserve luminous highlights and shadow detail, natural texture, neutral clothing and background. BOTTOM LEFT: realistic lush green mountain landscape with a blue lake, smooth blue sky and white clouds, colorful small wildflowers foreground, natural noon exposure. BOTTOM MIDDLE: realistic nighttime city street after rain, deep blue sky, warm streetlamps and colorful small shop lights reflected in wet pavement, dark regions still retain details, no legible text. BOTTOM RIGHT: high-contrast sunlit still life by a window: white cotton cloth in sunlight with visible texture, black ceramic bowl in deep shade, a red apple and a yellow lemon, subtle bright specular reflections on a spoon, neutral wall. Lighting should vary per scene as described. All subjects fictional, no identifiable real people. Avoid beauty retouching, filters, vintage color grading, exaggerated saturation, logos, watermarks. Purpose is diverse synthetic photographic test inputs, not claimed real camera calibration.
```
